title: Drake Maye is having a rough game. It's not the worst Super Bowl performance by a QB, though

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Drake Maye is having a rough game. It's not the worst Super Bowl performance by a QB, though
sources.description: Drake Maye had a rough first half in Super Bowl LX against the Seattle Seahawks. But it's not the worst quarterback performance in Super Bowl history.
